Anonymised identifier representing the metering facility / building type (Office_A, Office_B, Warehouse, DataCenter, Canteen) to prevent individual occupancy exposure.
Target forecast variable representing active electric energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) consumed over the preceding recording interval.

Calendar classification indicating operating regimen: Weekday (Mon-Fri regular schedule), Weekend (Sat-Sun low occupancy), or Holiday (public holiday schedule).
